study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Ma et al., Journal of Behavioral Addictions, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Comparative analysis of cortical anatomy in male participants with internet gaming disorder or tobacco use disorder: Insights from normative modeling

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Use normative modeling of cortical thickness (CT) to compare developmental patterns and individual deviations in male Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) and Tobacco Use Disorder (TUD), to assess commonalities/differences and inform whether IGD aligns with addictions.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Both IGD and TUD show widespread cortical thinning; TUD exhibits more individualized and extensive deviations, with opposite CT deviation trends vs IGD in pericalcarine cortex and pars triangularis.
